name: Tal
summary: Tal is the primary wind rider master of Thunder Bluff, tending the city's aerial roost high above the plains of Mulgore. He provides seasoned wyverns to Horde travelers looking to traverse the vast reaches of Kalimdor.

sections.title: Keeper of the High Roost
sections.body: Perched upon the central mesa of Thunder Bluff, Tal manages the vital aerial thoroughfare connecting the tauren capital to the rest of the Horde. From his perch, he tends to the loyal wind riders, or wyverns, ensuring they are healthy, well-fed, and prepared for long-distance journeys across Kalimdor's rugged landscapes. Whether sending messengers down to Camp Taurajo or dispatching scouts across the Barrens to Orgrimmar, Tal maintains an indispensable lifeline that keeps the towering mesa city in constant touch with its allies.

faq.q: What role does Tal play in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Tal is Thunder Bluff's wind rider master. He oversees the roost atop the bluffs, caring for the winged beasts and chartering flights across Kalimdor for members of the Horde.
Tal connects Thunder Bluff to points across central and southern Kalimdor, including Camp Taurajo, the Crossroads, Orgrimmar, and distant wilderness outposts.

faq.q: Why are wind riders used instead of traditional mounts?
faq.answer: Thunder Bluff's sheer cliff faces and extreme elevation make ground travel slow and winding. Flying mounts such as wind riders provide swift, direct travel into and out of the towering mesa city without needing to traverse the elevators.

angles.text: For tauren venturing beyond their ancestral pastures, Tal provides the quickest and safest passage from their high bluffs into the broader world.
Tal maintains one of the Horde's key transit hubs in Kalimdor, directly linking the tauren capital with the Crossroads and Orgrimmar.
